title: Home Purchase Financing Late Charge — Amount Clause
content:
**Amount of a late charge on a Home Purchase Financing loan**

The late charge is the program's late-charge percentage of the monthly principal-and-interest amount, rounded half up to the cent, raised to the program's late-charge floor and capped at the program's late-charge cap. The percentage, floor and cap are the figures of the borrower's Home-Only Loan program in the program fee schedule; escrow is not part of the base.

Read as a definition of the quantity: first the percentage of the principal-and-interest amount, rounded to the cent; then, if that figure is below the floor, the floor; if above the cap, the cap; otherwise the figure itself.

### The late history count

The late charges counted for the late history are those assessed on the loan in the 12 whole months before the assessment date.

| Late charge assessed (hypothetical assessment date 2026-03-20) | Whole months before the assessment date | Counted for the late history |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-09-30 | 5 | yes |
| 2025-03-21 | 11 (and 27 days) | yes |
| 2025-03-20 | 12 | no |

### Worked figures (hypothetical program figures of 5.00 percent, a 10.00 floor and a 50.00 cap)

| Monthly principal and interest | Percentage amount | After floor and cap | Late charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 420.31 | 21.0155, rounded to 21.02 | within the floor and cap | 21.02 |
| 180.00 | 9.00 | raised to the floor | 10.00 |
| 1100.00 | 55.00 | held to the cap | 50.00 |
| 1000.00 | 50.00 | equal to the cap | 50.00 |
